description: Evaluate an intended EVM transaction before submission using deterministic RPC simulation signals and return a machine-readable STRAELO execution decision. The decision engine is deterministic for the same observed RPC evidence; live chain state may change between calls. USE WHEN: an agent needs to evaluate an EVM transaction before deciding whether to submit it. DO NOT USE WHEN: the transaction has already been submitted and the agent needs to look it up by transaction hash; use evm_transaction_hash_lookup instead. This product does not broadcast transactions and does not guarantee that an allowed transaction will execute successfully when later submitted. `from_address` is the sender whose execution context is simulated; `to_address`/`data`/`value` together form the intended transaction form. INCOMPLETE means simulation/provider evidence was insufficient for a conclusive execution decision and must not be treated as ALLOW. Returns ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK, or INCOMPLETE with the simulation evidence and execution signals produced by the current decision engine.

chain.description: EVM network where the transaction would be executed.
chain.title: Chain

data.description: EVM calldata hex for contract interaction. Must start with 0x. Empty calldata is represented as "0x".
data.title: Data

from_address.description: Actual EVM sender address whose execution context should be simulated. Required because contract behavior may depend on msg.sender, balances, permissions, ownership, or allowlists.
from_address.title: From Address

to_address.description: Intended recipient address or contract target for the transaction.
to_address.title: To Address

value.description: Native value in hex wei (atomic units, 10^18 wei = 1 ETH). Zero means no native value transfer.
value.title: Value

name: evm_transaction_execution_decision

decision.description: Pre-execution decision: ALLOW means simulation succeeded with no blocking signals; WARN means simulation succeeded with cautionary findings (e.g., approvals); BLOCK means deterministic simulation indicates execution would revert; INCOMPLETE means a technical/provider error prevented a conclusive decision.

title: EVM Transaction Execution Decision
